candidate_union_metadata.ordering_policy: next_session_review, WATCH, pending_verification, extended_wait; thscode within group; no score

research_policy: optional catalyst verification and risk checks; missing financials do not block technical publication

BREAKOUT.definition: C > prior_high60 AND amount/prior_adt20 >= configured_ratio AND close_location >= configured_threshold

WATCH.definition: C > MA20 > MA60 AND 0 <= (prior_high60-C)/ATR20 <= configured_distance AND ATR5/ATR20 <= configured_contraction

technical_signals.window_policy: prior_high60 and prior_adt20 exclude today; WATCH ATR/MA include today; entry ATR excludes today
